name: Jumbeaux's Sweets Judy Hopps Carrot Cupcake & Nick Wilde Red Velvet Cupcake
whyItWorks: Soft bakery cupcakes with cream cheese frosting; Nick Wilde's red velvet/chocolate cupcake is completely nut-free and seedless.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Nick Wilde Red Velvet / Chocolate Cupcake (or verify the Judy Hopps Carrot Cupcake has no walnuts/raisins) and scrape off half the heavy frosting.
watchOuts: High sugar and butter/cream cheese frosting
